items.prompt: When may Var(X+Y) be simplified to Var(X)+Var(Y) for finite second moments?

options.text: Whenever X and Y are measured in the same unit
options.why: Common units permit addition but do not remove dependence.

options.text: Whenever both variables have positive means
Whenever the two data columns have equal lengths
options.why: Shape alignment does not establish the probabilistic condition.

options.text: When their covariance is zero, including independent cases
options.why: The omitted cross-term is then zero.

items.explanation: The general formula includes 2Cov(X,Y). Independence is sufficient, but zero covariance is the direct condition for this equality.
